$description: How generators may use tokens. Category names under rawValueRestrictions are exactly the keys of token-catalog.json.

color.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

fontSize.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

fontWeight.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

fontFamily.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

borderRadius.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

spacing.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

breakpoint.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

elevation.note: Only elevation.diffused and elevation.none exist; do not invent shadows.

iconSize.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

duration.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

easing.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

speed.note: Raw literal values are not allowed; reference a catalog name.

semanticPreferred: Prefer semantic roles (semanticColor, semanticTypography, semanticRadius, semanticMotion) over foundation tokens where a role exists. Themed colour roles must be used (not fixed hex) so the .dark override on #problem works.
unknownTokens: A reference to a name absent from token-catalog.json is invalid; do not add new tokens while generating.
overrides: PageSpecs carry no per-instance style or token-override field. Styling is fully owned by the section/component contracts, so there is nothing at the PageSpec layer to validate or mutate for tokens. Token drift is therefore checked at the catalog/policy layer only (policy category names must resolve to catalog keys; every catalog name must exist in the token files).
